_doc: Round 5 paint-over for back at 144 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/back_144.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: face_base
layers.why: Face critic 2: a clean, lit face plane under the glance before the features go on (FC-P35).

layers.name: fringe_gaps
layers.why: Head and hair 4: 'split the fringe into tapered clumps with 1 px dark gaps'. On the glance a full repaint of the fringe (5 locks) read as a dark visor over the forehead, so only the gaps are cut into the render's own lit fringe.

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic (round 4, face 2): 'narrow, slanted almond eyes with a heavy 2-3 px dark upper-lash block, a dark-to-warm iris ramp and a small catchlight; make it about 1 px narrower and tilted up at the outer corner, a 2 px near-black upper-lash block running 1 px past the outer corner, an iris of deep indigo on top, desaturated blue in the middle and a 1 px pale lower catchlight; drop the pure cyan; lift the lid 1 px'. Back glance: the same eye, the pair on the head's tilt line.

layers.name: blush
layers.why: Attractiveness 3 (round 4): 'lock one signature expression (half-lidded smirk, one brow slightly raised) and carry it into the back and Q frames; never ship an open O mouth in a key pose'; face 2: 'the default mouth is a 2-3 px asymmetric smirk; blush as 1-2 px strokes under the eye, not a blob'.

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Attractiveness 3 (round 4): 'lock one signature expression (half-lidded smirk, one brow slightly raised) and carry it into the back and Q frames; never ship an open O mouth in a key pose'; face 2: 'the default mouth is a 2-3 px asymmetric smirk; blush as 1-2 px strokes under the eye, not a blob'. The idle's smirk carried to the back glance.

layers.name: strands_out
layers.why: Head and hair 4: loose strands breaking the outline.

layers.name: brows_far
layers.why: Attractiveness 3 (round 4): 'lock one signature expression (half-lidded smirk, one brow slightly raised) and carry it into the back and Q frames; never ship an open O mouth in a key pose'; face 2: 'the default mouth is a 2-3 px asymmetric smirk; blush as 1-2 px strokes under the eye, not a blob'. The far brow 1 px raised.

layers.name: fist
layers.why: Weapon-grip critic (round 4, grip 8: 4.5): 'idle/back hand swallowed by the dark sleeve ... pose the glaive hand below the disc with the palm/knuckles facing camera and the sleeve cuff pulled back 3-4 px'; body critic: 'a 4-5 px fist high on the haft with a gold cuff'. The back view's fist at the render's wrist_left (44.6, 74.2), the cuff where the forearm leaves toward the elbow (56, 87).

layers.name: tail_tips
layers.why: Body critic (round 4, arms and hands 6): 'the free hand is a detached blue claw at the hip'. It is the hair tail's azure tips by the glaive hand (the back view). Inside the hip box they take the hair's own violet ramp by value rank (the tips higher up keep the azure, DESIGN's identity).
